checks.text: The page heading is "Text Diff Checker".
With the "Original" pane empty and the "Revised" pane empty, clicking the button "Compare" shows the message "Enter text in both panes to compare".

Typing "Hello\nWorld" into the "Original" pane and "Hello\nEarth" into the "Revised" pane, then clicking "Compare", shows a diff result where the line "World" is marked as removed and the line "Earth" is marked as added.
With the "Original" pane containing "Hello" and the "Revised" pane containing "hello", clicking "Compare" shows the message "No differences found".

With the "Original" pane containing "Hello" and the "Revised" pane containing "hello", checking the checkbox labelled "Case sensitive" and clicking "Compare" shows a diff result where "Hello" is marked as removed and "hello" is marked as added.
With the "Original" pane containing "Hello\nWorld" and the "Revised" pane containing "Hello\nEarth", clicking the button "Copy diff" shows the toast "Diff copied to clipboard".
With the "Original" pane containing "Hello\nWorld" and the "Revised" pane containing "Hello\nEarth", clicking the button "Download diff" triggers a file download named "diff.txt".
With the "Original" pane containing "Hello\nWorld" and the "Revised" pane containing "Hello\nEarth", clicking the tab labelled "Summary" shows the text "1 line removed, 1 line added".

Reload keeps the last comparison: after typing "Hello\nWorld" into "Original", "Hello\nEarth" into "Revised", and clicking "Compare", reloading the page still shows the diff result with "World" marked as removed and "Earth" marked as added.
